theme.appSubtitle: Cycle‑aware planning for women who train, perform, and manage high‑output routines.

menstrual.label: Menstrual Phase
menstrual.desc: Rest & restore. Your body is shedding — honor it. Light movement, warmth, and gentle nourishment are your medicine right now.

tags: A slow walk if you feel like moving

menstrual.note: Your body is working overtime right now. The best workout today might be a short walk and an early night. No guilt if you rest.

follicular.label: Follicular Phase
follicular.desc: Energy is rising, creativity is blooming. This is your best time to learn something new, start new routines, and push your training forward.
follicular.note: Your energy is building — now's the time to schedule the thing you've been putting off. Your body and mind learn fastest in this phase.

ovulatory.label: Ovulatory Phase
ovulatory.desc: Peak power, peak confidence. You are magnetic right now. Push your hardest workouts — your body can handle it and your mind is sharp.

tags: Confidence is at its peak — use it

ovulatory.note: This is your window. Whatever you've been hesitating on — do it now. Your body is strong, your mind is clear, and your confidence is at its peak.

luteal.label: Luteal Phase
luteal.desc: Progesterone is rising — you may feel more inward. Ease up intensity gradually and prioritize recovery this phase.
luteal.note: Honor the slowdown. Your body is preparing. Swap intensity for consistency — gentle lifting, good food, good sleep.

hormoneModel.disclaimer: Modeled from your cycle day — not bloodwork. Use as a guide.

menstrual.note: Swap full sessions for stretching, floor work, or a walk.

follicular.note: Great window to build — technique work and progressing your training.

ovulatory.note: Peak power and confidence. Push your hardest sessions here.

luteal.note: Dial back impact as the phase progresses. Consistency over intensity.

menstrual.note: Low-stakes days — review, light admin, or rest your mind along with your body.

follicular.note: Focus is coming online — a good window to learn something new or start a project.

ovulatory.note: Sharpest, most social thinking of the cycle — great for collaboration or performance-heavy work.

luteal.note: Detail-oriented focus shines here — editing, planning, and wrapping up loose threads.

cycleFocusOptions.label: 💪 Build Strength
cycleFocusOptions.note: Heavy lifts are prioritized in follicular & ovulatory. Luteal gets moderate strength. Menstrual gets rest.

cycleFocusOptions.label: 🔥 Lean Out
cycleFocusOptions.note: HIIT and cardio are balanced with strength. Food guidance leans toward protein and reduced inflammation.

cycleFocusOptions.label: 🧘 Flexibility & Recovery
cycleFocusOptions.note: Yoga sessions are longer and more specific. Recovery is built in every phase.

cycleFocusOptions.label: ✨ All-Around
cycleFocusOptions.note: A balanced approach — strength, flexibility, cardio, and rest are all part of your plan.

food.intro: Eat intuitively — these are phase-matched principles, not a strict meal plan.

menstrual.headline: Iron, warmth & anti-inflammatory
eat: Iron-rich foods (leafy greens, lentils, red meat)
menstrual.note: Your iron drops when you bleed. Pair iron-rich foods with vitamin C to boost absorption.

follicular.headline: Light, fresh & fermented
follicular.note: Estrogen is rising and your gut loves diversity. Good phase for trying new foods and meal prepping.

ovulatory.headline: Raw, vibrant & high-protein
ovulatory.note: Fiber helps clear excess estrogen through the gut. Stay hydrated, especially if training hard.

luteal.headline: Grounding, complex carbs & magnesium
luteal.note: The carb cravings are real and hormonal — feed them smart. Complex carbs boost serotonin, magnesium reduces cramping.

menstrual.reason: Low hormones + bleeding — protect cortisol. Eat enough.

follicular.reason: Best insulin sensitivity of your cycle.

ovulatory.reason: Good tolerance. Don't fast on your heaviest training days.

luteal.reason: Progesterone raises cortisol sensitivity. Long fasts worsen PMS.

milestones.label: Glycogen depleting
milestones.bio: Your body is burning through stored glucose.
milestones.craving: Drink water with a pinch of sea salt.

milestones.label: Ketone shift begins
milestones.bio: Insulin is dropping — shift toward fat oxidation begins.

milestones.label: Autophagy warming up
milestones.bio: Cellular cleanup is starting. Growth hormone is rising.

milestones.label: Deep fat burn
milestones.bio: Full fat-burning mode. Mental clarity peaks here for many people.
milestones.craving: Break your fast with protein first, then fats, then carbs.

milestones.label: Extended fast
milestones.craving: Bone broth or a small protein snack to ease back in.
